description: Unchanged canonical TASK-006 Store: schema5 mixed raw/ordinary batch, single, worn lots, unknown/refined crit owners, late stock and merged output, exact mixed and expired receipts.
ddl: CREATE TABLE commands(owner TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(owner),key TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,result TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(owner,key))

CREATE TABLE groups(owner TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(owner),scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('original','work')),id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,tier INTEGER NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL, crit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',PRIMARY KEY(owner,scope,id))
CREATE TABLE history(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(owner),body TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE oidc_codes(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE players(owner TEXT PRIMARY KEY,revision TEXT NOT NULL,level TEXT NOT NULL,experiment TEXT NOT NULL,started INTEGER NOT NULL,spent TEXT NOT NULL,equipment TEXT NOT NULL, worn_ranges TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]')
CREATE TABLE sessions(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT REFERENCES players(owner),csrf TEXT NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,flow TEXT)

CREATE TABLE work_lots(owner TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(owner),origin TEXT NOT NULL,start TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,born TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,tier INTEGER NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,crit TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(owner,origin,start))
CREATE INDEX command_expiry ON commands(created) WHERE result<>''
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX groups_work_stack ON groups(owner,kind,tier,value,crit) WHERE scope='work'
